name: bip-bup
description: Plays a soft robot "beep bop boop" when a request turns out long, agent-heavy or token-heavy; in PM Mode it asks Claude where things stand.

sound.title: Sounds
sound.description: Play the sounds; the toast shows either way

pmMode.title: PM Mode
pmMode.description: When a request is taking a while, ask Claude "Where are we on this?" and show its answer in the toast. Uses a few tokens each time

longSeconds.title: Seconds before 'taking a while'
longSeconds.description: Seconds a request may run, not counting time spent waiting on you, before the sound plays

stillMinutes.title: Minutes before 'still going'
stillMinutes.description: Minutes after which a request still running plays the sound once more; 0 turns it off

agents.title: Subagents before 'agents at work'
agents.description: Subagents started by one request that play the sound

outputTokens.title: Tokens before 'so many tokens'
outputTokens.description: Tokens Claude writes in one request, its subagents included, that play the sound

steps.title: Steps before 'big job'
steps.description: Model steps (roughly, tool calls) in one request that play the sound

volume.title: Volume (%)
volume.description: Loudness as a percent of the recorded level, from 0 to 400
